# Zotero fixtures

Responses in the shape Zotero's local API returns, written by hand from Zotero's own source (`chrome/content/zotero/xpcom/server/server_localAPI.js`) and its web API documentation. They are not recordings of a real library.

`test/zotero.test.ts` and `test/zotero-library.test.ts` read them. [docs/zotero.md](../../../docs/zotero.md) says what each call asks for and what each item becomes.
